title: Make Gym Logger your own
summary: Arrange your Home Screen, personalise your profile, and explore the app guide.
changes: Tap the pencil on Today to rearrange the actual cards, with a gentle iOS-style wiggle and a drag handle at each card's top right.

Use the minus buttons to hide cards or Add sections to restore them. Save your layout across devices, Cancel edits, or Reset to the defaults. Keyboard arrow keys work on the drag handles; reduced motion turns off the wiggle.
Keep active workouts visible while arranging Home, and see a cleaner History calendar without the swipe hint.
Follow the feature tour with highlighted controls, Next, Back and Skip.
Send private feedback or feature requests from Settings or the tour, with clear delivery details.
See Home Screen installation steps before the tour ends, using gym-logger.duckdns.org.
Open Settings from every main tab to replay the guide or find installation help.
Expand the next-workout arrow to read its explanation and last-session details.
Add, change or remove a private profile photo in Profile; it replaces your initial on Today.
See illustrated release announcements and open their screenshots full size.

image.alt: Today edit mode showing the actual workout and stat cards, minus buttons at the top left, drag handles at the top right, Save layout, Cancel and Add sections.
